categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies net_processing to change how transaction INVs are handled during transaction relay.
categories.rationale: Prevents redundant processing of conflicting transaction announcements in net_processing. Commit 83941a40d1 notes 'There is no reason we should process conflicting advertisements for transactions... Avoid processing these and doing spurious work', providing a modest resource optimization for node transaction relay on the maintenance branch.
